findings.problem: Finished books disappear from the active library because only Reading is rendered.
findings.resolution: Render separate Reading and Finished shelves, default visible, with a reversible Hide Finished Books setting and empty-state recovery.

findings.problem: Ordinary scrolling repeatedly publishes zero search pull progress and recalculates library ordering.
findings.resolution: Observe clamped overscroll, guard unchanged publication values, and cache library shelf sorting on collection updates.

findings.problem: Zero-sized cold cover views render a fallback bitmap and immediately render again at their final size.
findings.resolution: Wait for valid layout bounds before rendering placeholders.

findings.problem: Cover status overlays are ignored by the parent accessibility element.
findings.resolution: Include unread count and finish date in the cover accessibility value; hide duplicate overlay announcements.

design_evidence: Native production component captures with text-only first-party fixtures; not marketing screenshots.
limitations: Physical Duo pose screenshots unavailable because its connected screen viewer is black. Compact/wide reader direction is covered by integration tests.
distribution_scope: Upload only; preserve the existing hold on beta review and external-group attachment.
